dog.description_text:
Introducing Skyes! With his adorable face, goofy personality, and those BIG, tall ears that say it all, Skyes is ready to steal your heart! This 4-month-old, 10-pound Lab mix is the perfect combination of playful, silly, and sweet, and he's on the hunt for a forever family to share all of life's little adventures with. Skyes has a knack for making everyone smile. He loves sticking out his tongue, showing off his goofy side, and flopping right over for belly rubs the second he spots his favorite person. He's always ready to turn an ordinary day into something special, whether that means heading out for a walk, tagging along on a road trip, or soaking up the sunshine while strutting his stuff down the street. Skyes is ready to be your little sidekick, your walking buddy, your sunshine companion, and the reason you smile a little bigger every day. He's still a young pup with so much to learn, but with love, patience, and a family willing to show him the ropes, this little guy has all the makings of an amazing lifelong companion. If you're looking for a happy-go-lucky pup with oversized ears, a silly tongue, and a heart full of love, Skyes is ready to meet you!

Skyes is neutered, microchipped, and up to date on his vaccinations. For more information about him, please fill out an application at www.ALRcares.com and email Shruti@alrcares.com. We schedule meet and greets for approved adopters only, an application is the first step in our approval process. Thank you!
